cards.name: King T'Challa // Black Panther, Hope Enduring

Hawkeye, Trick Shot.text: Every Hero entering deals damage equal to your Hero count (32 Heroes): removal and reach off cards you cast anyway. Combos with Tellah's Hero tokens. Proposed for The Sentry.

Wraith, Vicious Vigilante.text: Unblockable double strike 1/1 Hero for 3: Sword of Fire and Ice, Buster Sword and The Key to the Vault each trigger twice a combat. Best lone attacker for Nick Fury, Spymaster. Proposed for Donatello.

Sword of Fire and Ice.text: +2/+2, protection from red and blue, 2 damage and a card on every hit. MV 3: Liberator tutors it, First Avenger and Frodo attach it free. Proposed for Wondrous Revival.

Nahiri, Heir of the Ancients.text: +1 makes a 1/1 and attaches an Equipment; −2 digs six for Equipment or Warrior (Frodo); −3 deals twice your Equipment count. Proposed for Iron Man Armor.

Nick Fury, Spymaster.text: Attack alone: draw, then put a 3-or-less creature from hand in tapped, attacking and indestructible (Hawkeye MM, Frodo, Kilo, Wraith, Matt Murdock). Nick Fury's dig still triggers. Proposed for Team Transmitter.

Frodo, Determined Hero.text: 2-drop: on enter or attack, attach an MV 2-3 Equipment free (7 left after the cuts); damage to him prevented on your turn. Halfling, not a Hero. Proposed for Iron Man, Titan of Innovation.

Hawkeye, Master Marksman.text: 2-drop Hero, first strike and reach; each tap can buy unblockable, 2 damage or a loot. Living Legend untaps him for a second trigger. Proposed for Conqueror's Flail.

Kilo, Apogee Mind.text: Haste; proliferates whenever tapped, twice a turn with Living Legend. Feeds Coulson, Team Leader, Iron Spider and Captain Marvel's counters. Not a Hero. Proposed for Lady Octopus.

Tellah, Great Sage.text: Each noncreature spell makes a 1/1 Hero token (Hawkeye TS ping, Team Leader counter, Avengers Assemble draw); 4+ mana spells draw two. Proposed for Origin of Iron Man.

Gideon Blackblade.text: 4/4 indestructible attacker on your turn, so his attack triggers Nick Fury; +1 gives a creature indestructible, lifelink or vigilance. Restores protection. Proposed for Vision, Spectral Synthezoid.

Matt Murdock, Justice Seeker.text: 2-drop Hero: {1} each combat puts a counter on a creature, and every creature with a counter has ward 1, which protects Nick Fury once he has one. Proposed for Blue Marvel.

The Wandering Emperor.text: Flash planeswalker: −2 exiles a tapped creature, +1 counter and first strike, −1 a 2/2. Not a Hero. Swapped out for Matt Murdock on 2026-11-08.

Daredevil, Man Without Fear.text: Vigilance, haste; on each attack exile the top card, +2/+1 and play it if it is a Hero. A second attack-trigger card engine beside Nick Fury.

King T'Challa // Black Panther, Hope End.text: Flash 3-drop Hero: draw whenever a player draws their second card each turn; flips to a double strike, damage-proof Black Panther that draws on hits.

Celestial Armor.text: Flash Equipment: attaches on entry and gives hexproof and indestructible this turn, so it saves Nick Fury in response. MV 3, so Liberator can tutor it.

Monica Rambeau // Photon, Living Light.text: 3-drop flying prowess Hero; the hexproof back face puts a counter on each other creature whenever you cast a noncreature spell.

Blacksmith's Talent.text: Spice. Turn-one Sword token; level 2 attaches an Equipment each combat; level 3 gives equipped creatures double strike and haste on your turn.

Human Torch, Johnny Storm.text: Spice. 1 damage to the opponent whenever you draw with another Hero out; the deck draws every turn.

Cayth, Famed Mechanist.text: Every other nontoken creature gets fabricate 1: a counter or a Servo artifact (Sami, Machinist's Arsenal). {2},{T}: proliferate or populate. Not a Hero.

Hero of Bladehold.text: Battle cry plus two attacking 1/1s each attack. Strong card but not a Hero, so it costs Nick Fury dig density.

Teferi, Hero of Dominaria.text: +1 draws and untaps two lands; −3 tucks any nonland permanent. Strong, but 5 mana and not a Hero.

Sword of Truth and Justice.text: +2/+2, protection from white and blue, a counter and proliferate on hits. Sword of Fire and Ice is the better Sword here.

Hero's Heirloom.text: 2 mana: +2/+1, and a legendary carrier (almost everything here) gets trample and haste. A Frodo target.

Basri Ket.text: +1: counter and indestructible (protection); −2 makes a 1/1 per attacking nontoken creature. Gideon covers the protection role.

Captain America, Steve Rogers.text: Lifelink; each attack gives another creature a counter and indestructible. Good, but another WW 5-drop (cut 2026-10-19 for Donatello).

Black Panther, Most Dangerous.text: Redirects damage dealt to him, but Hyperion prevents all but 1 damage to your Heroes, so he redirects 1.

Brigone, Soldier of Meletis.text: Heroic triggers off your own equip targeting; draws by removing counters. Not a Hero.

Nahiri, Storm of Stone.text: First strike on your turn and equip costs {1} less; −X hits a tapped creature.

Amazing Spider-Girl.text: 5/4 flying vigilance Hero; web-slinging for {2}{W} re-buys a Liberator or Hawkeye enters trigger.

Night Nurse, Healer of Heroes.text: Flash lifelink 2-drop Hero that returns a permanent that died this turn.

Embercleave.text: CRAFT (mythic). Flash, costs {1} less per attacker, double strike and trample. Worth it after the lands.

Silver Sable, Mercenary Leader.text: 3-drop Hero: a counter on entry, lifelink on attack. Outclassed by the other 2-3 drops.

Falcon, Joaquin Torres.text: Flying lifelink 2/2 Hero; battalion growth. Outclassed.

Spider-Suit.text: Makes a non-Hero a Spider Hero, but equip {3} is steep for that.

Luxior, Giada's Gift.text: Spice with Gideon or Nahiri (planeswalker becomes a creature); little else here.

Sanctuary Warden.text: 6 mana; the curve is being lowered.

The Eternal Wanderer.text: 6 mana; strong but against the curve plan.

Doctor Strange, Surgeon.text: Wants heavy lifegain the deck does not have.

Silver Surfer, Galactus's Herald.text: 5-mana colourless 4/5 flier Hero; its tutor is for Galactus.

Seachrome Coast.text: CRAFT land (rare): untapped W/U on turns 1-3. With four other crafts, tapped lands go from 3.4 to 1.9 points a card. For Temple of Enlightenment.

Inspiring Vantage.text: CRAFT land (rare): untapped R/W early. For Asgardian Citadel.

Shivan Reef.text: CRAFT land (rare): always-untapped U/R painland. For Stark Industries.

Battlefield Forge.text: CRAFT land (rare): always-untapped R/W painland. For Temple of Triumph.

Sulfur Falls.text: CRAFT land (rare): U/R, untapped with an Island or Mountain. For Temple of Epiphany.
